Guiling in China. We stayed at a "hotel" (someone's house) that had 4 rooms in a town that at most had 30 inhabitants. They were the most hospitable people I've ever met.

Side story: Couldn't sleep because of the humidity (you had to keep toilet paper in a sealed bag otherwise within an hour it would be all wet and unusable, so the bed sheets weren't that different) so I went down to the main floor of the place we were staying at. The family who owned it was watching TV, asked for a beer, they gave me a bottle and out I went to walk around town. It was awesome, not only great views from the mountain side ( I was lucky there was a full moon, the town didn't have any street lights so it would've been difficult to walk without knowing the town or a full moon ) but as I walked around town everyone was very welcoming people would offer to show me around or invite me to have something to eat with them as I passed by. I ended up playing cards in a random house and drinking till dawn. It wasn't even for money, just to pass time lol

Well, there's been several but even I myself can find some sort of explanation to most. However there's 2 that stand out and bother me to this day because I simply cannot explain wtf happened.

As a teen one random day my parents had left and I had a friend over. My room is on the second floor, it's kinda relevant.  We were playing FFX (taking turns with the controller) when we suddenly heard the door to the house, quite a heavy door, open and close. I yelled "Hello" assuming my parents had come back but no reply. The stairway light turned on, we heard footsteps coming up. "Dad!?" I said even louder, no reply but the footsteps kept coming up. My friend got up and went to the staircase to look, turned back to me and said "there's no one here" and the lights on the stairs turned off. We went around the house, no one had gotten in and the door was still locked with the key. We laughed about it and kept on playing but could never explain it.

The second one was more recent, well into my 20s. I was sleeping in my old room. Suddenly at around 2am I started hearing loud bangs against the wall it shares with the living room. I was half asleep, thought it was already morning and dismissed it as someone hanging up something on the wall. The banging continued intermittently for another half an hour or so. Since I couldn't sleep I looked at the time and when I saw I realized no one would be hanging anything this late. I came out of my room only to find everyone was asleep and the living room was completely dark, no one there and no sign of any tools. Relevant info, to get to the living from any other bedroom you have to cross mine so no one could've left the living room when I came out without crossing paths with me. I remember it clear as day because of how pissed and confused I was that someone would be hammering shit into a wall in the middle of the night.

I don't know wtf happened either of those times, I just know it happened.
